authority: AI Loop V3 — FULLY AUTONOMOUS. All 3 FUTURE_NOVEL candidates killed. Loop generates new 2029 hypotheses from failures.

failure_analysis.summary: All 3 FUTURE_NOVEL candidates (Neurovascular Control Plane, Therapeutic State Control, Autonomous Thrombectomy State Engine) were KILLED by light simulation. The failures share a common pattern.
failure_analysis.the_common_pattern: All three candidates proposed to improve prediction/control by FUSING multiple existing signals. In every case, the fusion provided NO incremental value over the best single signal. This is because all signals derive from the same underlying physical state — they are correlated by construction.
failure_analysis.the_lesson: Signal fusion is NOT a moat. If signal B is derivable from signal A (even partially), adding B to A provides no new information. A genuine moat requires an observable that is NOT derivable from any combination of existing signals.

per_candidate_lessons.NCP_killed: ICP alone predicts disease trajectory as well as ICP+flow+drug+activity+posture. The additional signals are correlated with ICP through the shared causal variable (device degradation). Adding them introduces noise without new information.
per_candidate_lessons.TSC_killed: PD-based control (effect) is worse than PK-based control (concentration) because the effect signal is noisier and the control path is indirect. Controlling on a noisy proxy of a hidden state is worse than controlling on a direct measurement of an observable state.
per_candidate_lessons.TSE_killed: Force alone predicts fragmentation as well as force+flow+AE. AE is redundant because micro-fractures that produce AE also change force/flow. The signals are causally linked — measuring the same event through different modalities.

the_new_moat_requirement.rule: A candidate can only survive if it provides an observable that is NOT derivable from any combination of existing signals.
what_does_NOT_work: Fusing more signals (correlated signals add no information)
Better ML on existing signals (the information bottleneck is in the SIGNALS, not the algorithm)
Controlling on a proxy of a hidden state (noise amplification exceeds information gain)
what_MIGHT_work: A genuinely new PHYSICAL observable that measures a different aspect of the system
A CAUSAL intervention that changes the system state (not just observes it)
A TEMPORAL advantage — detecting something earlier that existing signals cannot detect because they measure a LATER stage of the causal chain

new_2029_hypotheses.authority: CEO Round 169: 'Find an information bottleneck that the best existing technology cannot resolve.' Round 177 applies this lesson: the bottleneck must be PHYSICAL, not algorithmic.

hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.name: Temporal Observable Lead — detecting the causal chain at an EARLIER stage than any existing signal
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.the_insight: Existing signals (ICP, force, flow, AE) all measure EFFECTS of device degradation. The CAUSE is biological fouling of the shunt (protein accumulation, cell adhesion, tissue ingrowth). This fouling occurs BEFORE it affects hydraulic resistance, BEFORE it changes ICP, and BEFORE it produces symptoms. If we could observe fouling directly, we would have a temporal lead that no existing signal can match.
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.what_exists_2026: ICP sensors, flow sensors, AI prediction — all measure downstream effects
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.the_2029_gap: Direct observation of the CAUSE (biofouling) rather than the EFFECT (pressure/flow change)
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.information_bottleneck: Biofouling is not observable with current implantable sensors. It requires either: (a) a new sensor modality (e.g., optical, impedance, ultrasound backscatter) that can measure surface deposition on the shunt, or (b) an indirect observable that precedes hydraulic resistance change
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Device vendors optimize hydraulic performance, not biological interface monitoring. The fouling problem is known but nobody has a sensor for it.
hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.why_they_will_want_it: Biofouling is the #1 cause of shunt failure. Predicting it before hydraulic symptoms would eliminate 50%+ of shunt revisions.

moat_analysis.temporal: STRONGEST — observes the CAUSE days/weeks before any EFFECT is detectable

moat_analysis.integration: MODERATE — works with existing shunt hardware but needs new sensor
moat_analysis.ip: STRONG — the sensor modality + causal model can be patented

hypothesis_1_TEMPORAL_OBSERVABLE_LEAD.novelty_confidence: NOT YET SEARCHED — requires deep novelty search for biofouling sensors in shunt systems

hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.name: Causal Intervention — not predicting failure but CHANGING the trajectory
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.the_insight: All killed candidates tried to PREDICT better. But prediction without intervention is just a warning. The 2029 invention could be: a system that not only detects degradation but ACTIVELY INTERVENES to slow or reverse it. For example: automatically adjusting shunt valve settings to redistribute flow and reduce fouling at the obstruction site, or triggering a localized drug release to dissolve early biofouling.
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.what_exists_2026: Adjustable valves (passive), drug pumps (open-loop), AI prediction (passive)
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.the_2029_gap: CLOSED-LOOP intervention — detect early degradation → adjust device parameters → slow/reverse degradation → verify improvement
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.information_bottleneck: No system currently forms a closed loop from early degradation detection to device parameter adjustment to outcome verification. The loop is always human-mediated (doctor sees alert → doctor adjusts → patient returns for checkup).
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Closed-loop intervention requires regulatory approval for autonomous device adjustment — a higher bar than prediction. Competitors focus on prediction because it's lower risk.
hypothesis_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_NOT_PRE.why_they_will_want_it: Autonomous intervention eliminates the latency between detection and treatment. For shunt failure, this latency is currently days to weeks.

hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.name: Device-Free Physiological Observable — measuring patient state without any implanted device
hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.the_insight: All killed candidates assumed the patient has an implanted device (shunt, pump, sensor). But what if the 2029 invention is a NON-INVASIVE observable that replaces the need for device-based sensing? For example: a wearable or external sensor that measures a physiological signal (e.g., transcranial ultrasound, ocular parameters, gait analysis) that correlates with CSF dynamics well enough to predict shunt failure without ANY implanted sensor.
hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.the_2029_gap: Continuous, non-invasive, home-use monitoring of CSF dynamics
hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.information_bottleneck: No non-invasive, continuous, home-use technology can currently measure CSF dynamics. Existing methods (CT, MRI, lumbar puncture) are episodic and invasive.
hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Device vendors sell implanted hardware. A non-invasive solution competes with their own products. No vendor has incentive to cannibalize their implant business.
hypothesis_3_DEVICE_FREE_OBSERVABLE.why_they_will_want_it: Non-invasive monitoring eliminates surgical risk, enables screening, and expands the addressable market to patients who don't yet need a shunt.

the_generation_principle.old_approach: Fuse more signals → better prediction (FAILED — signals are correlated)
the_generation_principle.new_approach: Find a NEW observable that measures a DIFFERENT stage of the causal chain, or find a way to INTERVENE rather than just predict
the_three_directions: 1. Temporal Lead: observe the CAUSE (biofouling) before the EFFECT (ICP change)
2. Causal Intervention: not prediction but CLOSED-LOOP intervention to change trajectory
3. Device-Free: non-invasive observable that replaces implanted sensors entirely
the_generation_principle.why_these_are_stronger: Each has a PHYSICAL moat (new sensor modality, new control loop, or new non-invasive approach) — not just an algorithmic moat. The failures proved that algorithmic improvements on existing signals do not create moats.

next_autonomous_actions: 1. Deep novelty search for hypothesis 1 (biofouling sensor in shunt systems)
2. Deep novelty search for hypothesis 2 (closed-loop autonomous shunt intervention)
3. Deep novelty search for hypothesis 3 (non-invasive CSF dynamics monitoring)
4. If any survives at novelty level 2: light simulation to test the physical moat
5. If all fail: the loop has exhausted the current hypothesis space and must report to the CEO
